# -1 missing (no such character), 0 dead, 1 alive, 2 in the cabinet, 3 head of the cabinet
oe_yv_dev_bayan = {
    value = -1
    if = { limit = { character:yua_bayan_merkid ?= { always = yes } } value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { character:yua_bayan_merkid ?= { is_alive = yes } }
        value = 1
        if = { limit = { character:yua_bayan_merkid = { in_cabinet = yes } } value = 2 }
        if = { limit = { character:yua_bayan_merkid = { has_character_modifier = head_of_the_cabinet_modifier } } value = 3 }
    }
}

# ---- TEST ONLY (yuan-heir1): readings for the heir report oe_yv.91 ----
# CHI's heir: 0 none (or no CHI), 1 the crown prince, 2 El Tegus, 3 someone else
oe_yv_dev_hst = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_heir = yes } }
        value = 3
        if = { limit = { character:oe_s37_el_tegus ?= { is_heir_of = c:CHI } } value = 2 }
        if = { limit = { exists = global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince = { is_heir_of = c:CHI } } value = 1 }
    }
}
# the crown prince: 0 not made, 1 alive at the Yuan court, 2 alive elsewhere, 3 dead

    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { exists = global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince }
        value = 3
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince = { is_alive = yes } } value = 2 }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } } value = 1 }
    }
}

    }
